discription: A simple Frequency Modulation (FM) synthesizer with an ADSR envelope, allowing control over modulation ratio and index.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, ratio=1.5, index=5;    var car, mod, sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    mod = SinOsc.ar(freq * ratio, mul: freq * index);    car = SinOsc.ar(freq + mod);    sig = car * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
